title: Liqian Ren - In Search of Modern Alpha (S2E8)

reader_summary.headline: All opinions expressed by podcast participants are solely their own opinion.
reader_summary.overview: All opinions expressed by podcast participants are solely their own opinion. and do not reflect the opinion of newfound research. In this episode, I am joined by Li Chen Ren, Director of Modern Alpha at Wisdom Tree. After receiving her degree in computer science, Li Chen came to the United States to pursue her master's in economics.

key_points.text: Lechen then did a quick stint to the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago as an associate economist before returning back to academia to pursue her Ph.D.D..
key_points.evidence_quote: Lechen then did a quick stint to the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago as an associate economist before returning back to academia to pursue her Ph.D.D.

key_points.text: In 2007, Li Chen joined Vanguard's Investment Strategy Group, where she leveraged her background to perform economic and capital market forecasts.
key_points.evidence_quote: In 2007, Li Chen joined Vanguard's Investment Strategy Group, where she leveraged her background to perform economic and capital market forecasts, studies on asset allocation, and research into topics such as retirement income and investor behavior.
